lead: A file edited by a script comes back into your context whole.
body: The harness re-prints an on-disk change it did not make as a "changed on disk" reminder — a long module is thousands of tokens, more than the edit cost — and the Edit tool never triggers it. Take the heredoc/`nv splice` route only for an edit Edit genuinely cannot express (a non-unique anchor, a whole-field rewrite).
